description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the AuthenticationService component of the OrangeHRM system. It contains unit tests for the setCredentials method, covering various scenarios such as invalid credentials, employee status, user activation, and employee termination. The tests verify the behavior of the AuthenticationService in different edge cases by mocking dependencies and asserting expected exceptions or outcomes.

classes.name: AuthenticationServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing AuthenticationService's setCredentials method behavior under various conditions.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithInvalidCredentials
methods.description: Tests that setCredentials returns false when the UserService returns null credentials.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithNotAssignedEss
methods.description: Tests that setCredentials throws AuthenticationException with error code EMPLOYEE_NOT_ASSIGNED when user role is ESS.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithDisabledUser
methods.description: Tests that setCredentials throws AuthenticationException with error code USER_DISABLED when user account is disabled.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithTerminatedEmployee
methods.description: Tests that setCredentials throws AuthenticationException with error code EMPLOYEE_TERMINATED when employee is terminated.

methods.name: testsSetCredentialsWithoutEmployee
methods.description: Tests that setCredentials throws AuthenticationException with error code EMPLOYEE_NOT_ASSIGNED when user has no associated employee record.

methods.name: testsSetCredentials
methods.description: Verifies successful execution of setCredentials when valid user credentials are provided, ensuring session variables are set accordingly.
